videos.summary:
Janis Amolins on the worst scenario against a King's Move: you can't finish, so you just wait to see who gasses out first, and that lock doesn't get tired. Make him the one holding on instead. Full video with Janis is on the channel.

videos.title: Beating Bob Brown Is a Chess Game #armwrestling
videos.summary:

videos.title: Your Flop Press Needs 130 KG vs a King's Move #armwrestling
videos.summary:
I asked Janis Amolins how he made Bob Brown attack him. His answer: in a King's Move, if your flop press is over 130 kilos maybe you get through, otherwise you're stuck in the trap. Time to build my flop. Full video with Janis is on the channel.
